title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park on 1969-07-12
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park
lineage: Low Gen AUD + SBD > MC > Cass > DAT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough audience recording but the second disc shines with a monster Dark Star, The Eleven and a wild Lovelight jam.
ai_review.review: The set is split into two very different halves – the first seven songs suffer from distorted, hissy audience tape, while the latter half (starting with Dark Star) offers solid sound and classic late‑’69 jamming. Reviewers rave about the extended Dark Star, The Eleven, Lovelight and the quirky Bob‑Weir interview bits, even though the overall audio quality is uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical highlights on disc 2 despite consistent complaints about the poor first‑disc audio; the weighted average of show quality (70%) and recording quality (30%) yields a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First disc is described as rough, distorted, hissy and low‑fidelity; second disc is noticeably cleaner with fewer tape issues but still not perfect.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑disc structure – a shaky opening set followed by an extended, high‑energy second half that flows well into long jams and quirky stage antics.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) is noted for doing "man on the street" interview bits during Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pigpen tries to get Mickey Hart to sing; no specific drumming commentary.
